title: Built to make personal flight possible.
lede: Founded in 2022 in Hangzhou. We build our own avionics, flight control, propulsion and airframes, and around 70% of our team works in R&D.
quote: We are not just manufacturing aircraft; we are architecting a new way of life. We aim to make personal eVTOL as ubiquitous as bicycles: affordable and accessible to everyone in the world.
